# R basics

## R as a calculator

```{r}
#| echo: true
2 + 3
sqrt(16)
```

## Objects and functions

```{r}
#| echo: true
ages <- c(34, 52, 61, 45)
mean(ages)
```

::: {.key-findings}
`<-` stores a value in an object. Read it as **"gets"**.
:::

# Your data

## Importing a CSV file

```{r}
#| echo: true
patients <- read.csv("../../data/patients.csv")
head(patients, 4)
```
